name: Simple EA MA plus MACD
summary: This EA combines a Moving Average crossover or filter with the MACD indicator to generate trend-following trade signals. It enters long positions when the MA signals an uptrend and MACD confirms bullish momentum, and enters short positions under the opposite conditions. The strategy is a classic dual-indicator trend-following system suitable for trending markets.
summary_zh: 该EA结合移动均线交叉或过滤与MACD指标来生成趋势跟踪交易信号。当均线信号显示上升趋势且MACD确认看涨动能时做多，反之做空。这是一个经典的双指标趋势跟踪系统，适用于趋势行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用移动均线判断趋势方向，同时用MACD指标确认动量，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件方面，当价格位于MA之上（或快线上穿慢线）且MACD柱状图为正或信号线上穿时做多；做空条件相反。出场条件通常依赖MACD反向交叉或MA趋势反转信号，也可能设有止损和止盈参数。仓位管理方面，EA提供固定手数参数，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，该EA通常设有最大持仓限制和止损设置，但基础的移动均线加MACD组合缺乏自适应仓位调整和回撤控制机制。整体策略在强趋势市场中表现良好，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept uses a Moving Average to determine trend direction and the MACD indicator to confirm momentum, representing a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions involve going long when price is above the MA (or a fast MA crosses above a slow MA) and MACD histogram is positive or the signal line crosses upward; short conditions are the reverse. Exit conditions typically rely on MACD reverse crossovers or MA trend reversal signals, and may also include configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters. Position sizing uses fixed lot parameters, though some variants may include balance-based dynamic lot calculation. Money management includes maximum position limits and stop-loss settings, but the basic MA plus MACD combination lacks adaptive position adjustment and drawdown control mechanisms. The overall strategy performs well in strong trending markets but is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging or choppy conditions.

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Overall take profit target in points

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试，适合初学者学习EA开发
双指标确认机制（MA+MACD）减少了单一指标产生的虚假信号
参数可配置性强，用户可根据不同品种和周期灵活调整指标参数
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy to understand and debug, suitable for beginners learning EA development
Dual indicator confirmation mechanism (MA+MACD) reduces false signals from a single indicator
Highly configurable parameters allow users to flexibly adjust indicator settings for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 在震荡行情中移动均线和MACD都会产生大量虚假信号，导致频繁开平仓亏损
缺乏高级资金管理机制，如动态仓位调整、最大回撤控制和新BAR检查
默认止损和止盈为零，用户必须手动设置否则交易风险极高
cons_en: Both MA and MACD generate numerous false signals during ranging markets, leading to frequent opening and closing of losing trades
Lacks advanced money management mechanisms such as dynamic position sizing, maximum drawdown control, and new bar checking
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, users must manually configure them or face extremely high trading risk
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器和震荡识别机制，如ADX指标，在低趋势强度时暂停交易以避免震荡行情中的虚假信号
实现基于账户权益的动态仓位管理和最大回撤限制，提高资金安全性和策略鲁棒性
improvements_en: Add a trend filter and ranging market detection mechanism, such as the ADX indicator, to pause trading during low trend strength and avoid false signals in sideways markets
Implement equity-based dynamic position sizing and maximum drawdown limits to improve capital safety and strategy robustness

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为零，若用户未手动配置则交易无任何保护，存在无限亏损风险
缺乏新BAR检查机制，可能在同一K线内反复开仓平仓造成过度交易
趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中会产生连续亏损，缺少整体回撤控制
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, creating unlimited loss risk if users do not manually configure them
Lacks new bar checking mechanism, potentially causing excessive trading by repeatedly opening and closing positions within the same candle
Trend-following strategy produces consecutive losses in ranging markets with no overall drawdown control
